help.title: Quick Start for AgentDock
help.description: AgentDock keeps Skills in canonical .agents folders, observes Harnesses read-only, and inventories MCP. Start with Install, organize in My Skills, then use Inventory and Project as needed.

workflows.title: Recommended Workflows
workflows.description: Install Skills into the user or project .agents/skills root. Use My Skills to organize, Inventory to observe Harness skills and MCP, Project for repo-local skills, and Settings for discovery and diagnostics.

presets.title: Presets
presets.description: Group Skills into named Presets for organization in My Skills. Preset membership is metadata only; it does not deploy, activate, or remove Harness files.

install.title: Install Skills
install.description: Install from local folders, Git repositories, archives, or the skills.sh CLI. All writes use the canonical .agents/skills roots.

sync.title: My Skills
sync.description: Browse the shared library, edit tags, inspect sources and updates, and organize Preset membership. Harness-specific folders are not deployment targets.

global.title: Inventory
global.description: Read-only view of Skills and MCP discovered in each Harness and native .agents consumer. Configure which discovery sources are visible in Settings.

projects.title: Project Workspaces
projects.description: Link a project to manage only <repo>/.agents/skills, compare it with the user library, and import or export project Skills. No per-agent deployment targets are selected.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure discovery paths and toggles, appearance, language, proxy, custom read-only paths, and diagnostics. AgentDock never writes Harness directories.
